text: いきてる　じゃん　だったら　せめて　せんとう　ふのうに　してやるか！

structure.jp: せめて　せんとう　ふのうに　してやるか！
structure.en: I'll at least make them faint!

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.span: せんとう　ふのうに　してやる
patterns.explanation: に plus する after a word means to make something be that way. せんとう　ふのうに　してやる = 'I'll make them unable to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you do the thing to someone, here in a rough, threatening way. してやる = 'I'll do it to them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on now; てる is the shortened spoken form. いきてる = 'they are alive'.
